messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: exhaustive combinatorial enumeration of order types with linear programming bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Exhaustive enumeration of the 11,384,290,602 abstract order types realizable by 13 points in the plane, filtered by the constraint that all coordinates lie in [0,1]^2 via a linear programming feasibility test, yields a unique optimal order type whose minimum-area triangle equals 1/148; furthermore, the LP relaxation over this enumerated set proves no order type of 13 points can achieve a minimum triangle area exceeding 1/148, establishing both the optimum and the uniqueness of the realizing configuration up to order-type isomorphism."}
